subject: Sensitivity tiering, reviewer access matrix, and comms variants for year-end cycle
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 28 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Sensitivity tiering, reviewer access matrix, and comms variants for year-end cycle

Team —

I've attached a first pass at a sensitivity-tier matrix and paired manager comm templates. Goal is to finalize access and messaging before the holiday freeze so managers can start scheduling calibration sessions in January. High-level asks: 

- Review the tier matrix and call out any job families we should override (column: suggested-tier).
- Marcus: confirm comp/legal constraints for tier-2 special cases (bonus/compacted review cycles).
- Priya: confirm forms we must route for privileged roles and whether we need separate e-sign flows.
- Stephanie: quick read for legal-safe language in the manager comms (esp. the wording around data retention).

Draft attachments: sensitivity-tier-matrix-v1.xlsx (tabbed by org), manager-brief-templates-v2.docx, comm-variants-weekly-anchors.pdf

Proposed timeline (brief):
- Dec 3: agree matrix and final templates
- Dec 6–10: produce manager pack and collateral hub link
- Dec 15: dry run with a pilot cohort (Sales & Platform)

I'll coordinate a short 30-minute sync if helpful — otherwise please leave comments on the Drive.

Thanks,
Jonas
Jonas Weber
Director, Business People Operations
Redwood Inference

Thanks — I reviewed the sheet and left inline comments on the Drive. A few operational points: 

- Privileged-role routing: We should use the separate Privileged-Review form (PR-2026-v2) for any Tier-1a/1b designations; that form triggers an additional acknowledgment and logs to our compliance bucket (retention: 7 years).
- E-sign flow: HR will own the e-sign for the privilege acknowledgment. If teams require a contractor exception, we'll route via a manual approval (Priya + Legal).
- Data access audit: Stephanie — we'll need a short blurb in the comms telling managers the review will surface access lists for verification (not punitive).

I uploaded the PR-2026-v2 form to the Drive: /HR/forms/PR-2026-v2.pdf

Priya

HRIS & Compliance Manager
Redwood Inference

- Tier overrides: Platform SRE L4/L5 flagged for Tier-2 subset (Marcus to flag comp exceptions).
- Privileged form: PR-2026-v2 required for Tier-1a/1b; contractors flagged as Tier-2 may need acknowledgment depending on access.

Action owners & deadlines:
- Marcus: comp-exception column in the matrix by 2026-12-04 (IMPT) — Marcus confirmed.
- Priya: confirm expedited contractor exception path and publish a short SOP by 2026-12-09.
- Stephanie: legal read of manager-comm language and the data-access blurb by 2026-12-06.
- Laura: run a 20-min dry run with pilot managers during week of Dec 15 (confirm attendees).
- Jonas: build the manager packet, hub link, and calendar invites for the pilot by Dec 10.

External note for Parkside: Sarah — if your clinician analyst is Tier-2 we'll ask for an emailed acknowledgment plus a light access checklist; Priya will confirm the expedited exception SOP.

Links:
- Drive (manager packet & forms): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1Yb-yr-example-drive-link

Thanks — and appreciate the quick turnaround.
